risks.title: Macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions
risks.summary: Las recesiones globales y las tensiones geopoliticas pueden reducir la demanda de productos de la Compania.
risks.literal_quote: A significant portion of the Company's net sales is generated outside of the United States, which exposes the Company to economic and political conditions in foreign markets.

risks.title: Foreign exchange volatility
risks.summary: La fortaleza del dolar estadounidense puede presionar los margenes en mercados internacionales.
risks.literal_quote: Weakness in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar adversely affects the U.S. dollar value of the Company's foreign currency-denominated sales.

forward_looking.text: The Company expects gross margin to improve modestly in fiscal 2026 driven by Services mix.
Management anticipates continued investment in R&D over the next 3 to 5 years.

management_tone.label: cautiously_optimistic
management_tone.rationale: Tono predominantemente positivo en perspectivas de Services y margenes, con menciones explicitas de incertidumbre en hardware sales y FX.

evidence_quotes.text: We are confident in our ability to drive long-term growth.
However, foreign exchange volatility may continue to pressure reported revenue.
